theirReference: It was a real pleasure to meet Cristian. He is very friendly, supportive, and easy to spend time with. We met several times in Bogotá, played board games, and had a great time together. He gave me lots of help and recommendations, which I really appreciated. I strongly recommend him to anyone, and I hope we will stay in touch and meet again. Thank you so much for everything, Cristian! See you! CJ
myReference: I met Jaroslav from Prague for a hangout here in Bogotá, and he is such a kind and easygoing person. We went to play board games together and had a great time—it was super fun and competitive, which made it even cooler. He is very intelligent, and we shared lots of travel experiences and recommendations about places to visit. I really enjoyed our time, and I definitely recommend him to the Couchsurfing community.
